sources.use: Published group assignment reference; workbook group rows are derived from Cup-highlighted schedule rows.

sourceReceipt.provenanceNote: Normalized from the two cited workbook sheets. Public game IDs map exactly from gameKey; groupId is attached only when both scheduled teams share a published Cup group and phase is in_season_tournament.

boundary.published: announcedGames contains the 1,200 published 2026-27 games only. The 60 Cup Group Play games are included in those published rows; source home/away, dates, times, phases, and published status are retained.
boundary.cupGroupPlay: The 60 published Cup Group Play games are standings-eligible and carry groupId. Their outcomes and overtime-point tiebreak ledger are not present here; callers must simulate them independently for each replay seed.
boundary.modeledCompletion: The remaining 30 matchups (60 team-game appearances) are intentionally not represented as published fixtures. A seeded caller may compile them only after all 60 schedule-linked Cup Group Play results, exact 2025-26 team records, and an explicit replay seed are available. Completion output is a modeled scenario, not an NBA-announced matchup list.
boundary.cupFinal: The NBA Cup Championship is not part of the standings-eligible 82-game schedule and is excluded from this artifact and regular-season standings.
boundary.sourceConflicts: Source-highlight conflict flags are retained per published game. Cup phase and group membership follow the reviewed workbook classification and assigned group map rather than highlight color alone.

integrity.hashPolicy: SHA-256 over UTF-8 canonical JSON with recursively sorted object keys and compact separators; publishedPayloadSha256 covers announcedGames and groups only.
